description: Crawl a public URL and return its content as plain text or HTML on the legacy Desearch /web/crawl route. The SDK marks webCrawl deprecated in favor of extract; this tool stays for parity with that route. Prefer extract for new integrations. API docs: https://www.desearch.ai/docs/guide/apis/extract-api
